description:
Secondary Shields Hullmods

Download Here:

Zip

Adds several hullmods that add additional shields to a ship.

These shields are weak, don't block collisions, and occasionally don't even block projectiles.

On the plus side, they dissipate small amounts of hard flux and run off of their own flux reactors, thus remaining functional even if your main reactor is overloading or venting.

While the Bubble shields are static, the Segmented shields rotate on their own, granting shifting coverage for when an individual emitter has overloaded.

Note: All shields become significantly worse when built-in to a ship.

aiDescription: Adds several hullmods that provide additional, weak shields which dissipate flux and run on their own reactors. These shields include static bubble types and rotating segmented types that offer shifting coverage. They are designed to remain functional even if the main reactor is overloaded, though they perform worse when built into a ship.
